author: Johannes Hanika
name: darktable Fuji film-simulation styles
description: Fuji film-simulation styles (Astia, Provia, Velvia, Classic Chrome, Monochrome, Reference; lo/hi variants) by darktable's original author, built from 49-patch colorchecker fits. The tar also ships the source colorchecker CSVs and Makefile used to generate the styles. Note: 2016 colorchecker+tonecurve fits from the pre-scene-referred era — kept as a valued-author exception.
